lines.zh: 我的皮几乎透明，看得见影子
lines.en: My pale hide shows my shadow through it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过硬实的土路
lines.en: I walk slowly along the packed path.
My hooves are quiet.

lines.zh: 我在阳光底下走得很慢
lines.en: I move slowly in the sunlight.
I drift toward an open clearing.
My snout brushes the grass tips.
I turn, and light slides over my hide.
I skirt a bramble.
I wander toward the village.
The grass springs back behind me.
I walk steadily, one step at a time.
My ears hang loose.
I pause outside the fence.
The wind makes my hide gleam.
I root about, unhurried.
I climb the slope without losing breath.
I stand, my hide glaringly pale.
I bask, warm all over.
I hold still like a stone.
I listen to the insects in the grass.
The sun is too bright to keep my eyes open.
I sniff the soil under my feet.
Wind passes over my ribs.
My snout keeps sniffing.
I am quiet and bother no one.
I shift into the shade.
I give a very soft grunt.
I watch the distant horizon.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，忘了放下来
lines.en: I raise a leg and forget to put it down.
There is enough grass here for a day.
Dust settles on my back.
I am thinking of nothing.
Have you been watching me?
My hide is far too conspicuous.
I turn slowly to face you.
Your hands smell of food.
I tilt my head and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看不太清远处
lines.en: I cannot see far very well.
You are standing rather close.
I bear you no ill will at all.
Your shadow falls on me.
My snout twitches.

lines.zh: 我想确定你是哪一种人
lines.en: I want to know what sort you are.
I step aside, then can't help looking back.
Startled, I back away.
A red mark appears on my pale hide.
The sound I make is short and hoarse.
That landed on my ribs.
My legs feel weak.
I shake the dust off.
I retreat to the fence.
My four legs feel unsteady.
I can still walk, slowly.
Do not let there be a second one.
That smells good.
I am walking over to you.
My snout gets there first.
Whatever you do, do not let your hand shake.
I eat slowly, be patient.
Not enough for a good chew.
I smell something sweet.
I will only take a very small bite.
I look up, wanting more.
Leave it on the ground and I will help myself.
My ears lift a little.
This beats grass.
I eat and watch you at the same time.

lines.zh: 你再给一点，我就跟着你
lines.en: A little more and I will follow.
I root up every last crumb.
I am full; thank you.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞在我身上了
lines.en: You walked right into me.
Your shove leaves my hide pink.
I take a step and clear the way.

lines.zh: 我这么显眼，你还能撞上
lines.en: I am this pale, and you still hit me.
Do not push, I am steady.
We brush past each other.
Your foot is on my hoof.
You bumped into me and I didn't even step aside.
We flatten a patch of grass.
I look back at you.
I approach her slowly.
Our hides match well.

lines.zh: 我们在树荫下并排站着
lines.en: We stand side by side in the shade.
She is much quieter than I am.
I shade her from the sun.
We root the same patch together.
My call is soft, and she hears it.
This ground is enough for us.
We walk at the same slow pace.
I follow her anywhere.
What falls is mine.
I shovel it over with my snout.
I sniff before eating.
It is dusty.
I drag it two steps in my teeth.
Too hard to chew.

lines.zh: 这是谁掉的，我先替你收着
lines.en: Whose is this? I will hold it for now.
I set it by my hoof.
I swallow it in one go.
I look up to see if anyone is watching.
Why are you following me?
I stop and face you squarely.
My ears are up.
I do not like being cornered.
I keep my eyes on both your hands.
One more step and I butt.
No one else here, just you.
I grunt, low.
I stand before the fence.
Do not back me into a corner.
I watch your hands from the corner of my eye.
I am waiting for you to take that step.
I edge sideways, step by step.

lines.zh: 我从鼻孔里重重哼一声
lines.en: I snort heavily through my nostrils.
If you retreat, I will not chase.
Head low, ready to butt.
My shadow touches yours.
I have not counted to three yet.
Push me further and I'll gore you.
Last chance. Walk away.
I lower my head and butt.
I hit your side.
That one had force behind it.
Once you step back, I pull my blow.
My head is a hard thing.
I charge, then pant.
I nip your sleeve.
That should send you back.
My hooves dig in.
After this, do not come again.
I come out from behind the fence.
A pale shape joins the plains.
I settle into the sunlight.

lines.zh: 我的皮在光亮里几乎透明
lines.en: My hide is almost see-through in the light.
First I found clean ground.
Nothing else is here.
I walk slowly to the shade.
The wind scatters my scent.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩上松软的土
lines.en: My hooves press into soft earth.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得让人放心
lines.en: This place is reassuringly quiet.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的皮，一片焦红
lines.en: Fire scorches my hide to red.
My feet slip and I land sitting.
Water closes over my head.
The blast throws me into the grass.
An arrow bites my shoulder.
Magic leaves me cold all over.
Hunger has me unsteady.
A white flash and my legs go weak.
The earth under me is gone.
